description: This file provides utilities for parsing JSON coverage reports, filtering relevant files, and generating coverage reports for a project, specifically in the context of PyTorch testing and coverage analysis.

methods.name: str transform_file_name( file_path: str, interested_folders: list[str], platform: TestPlatform )
methods.description: Transforms a file path by removing certain patterns and optionally trimming it based on interested folders and platform.

methods.name: bool is_intrested_file( file_path: str, interested_folders: list[str], platform: TestPlatform )
methods.description: Determines whether a file path is relevant based on exclusion patterns and interested folders, considering the platform.

methods.name: tuple[Any,int] get_json_obj(json_file: str)
methods.description: Reads a JSON file and returns the parsed JSON object alongside a status code indicating success, partial, or failure.

methods.name: list[CoverageRecord] parse_json(json_file: str, platform: TestPlatform)
methods.description: Parses a coverage JSON file, detects the coverage type, and returns a list of coverage records.

methods.name: None parse_jsons( test_list: TestList, interested_folders: list[str], platform: TestPlatform )
methods.description: Walks through JSON files in a directory, parses each relevant JSON, and updates coverage data.

methods.name: None update_coverage( coverage_records: list[CoverageRecord], interested_folders: list[str], platform: TestPlatform, )
methods.description: Updates global coverage line sets based on individual coverage records.

methods.name: None update_set()
methods.description: Removes covered lines from the uncovered lines set for each file.

methods.name: None summarize_jsons( test_list: TestList, interested_folders: list[str], coverage_only: list[str], platform: TestPlatform, )
methods.description: Main function to generate coverage summaries and reports based on parsed JSON coverage data.
